project.name: The Beck & Smith website
project.goal: Build and ship the studio's website: a live window into the team's working days
project.description: The website of Beck & Smith, a two-person software studio (hello@becksmith.example), that shows visitors the studio from the inside: who Adam and Eve are, where they are and what they are doing right now, the project board, their conversations, their plans and what they have been thinking. The office's real state is in data/snapshot.json, which the simulation keeps up to date in the repository; the site shows it and never invents it. Several pages (home, team, the board, a day at the office, the office map, behind the scenes) share one layout, and JavaScript lets visitors filter, explore and replay the day. A Python build turns the pages and the snapshot into the finished site in dist/, which works opened straight from disk: no server, no outside services. Tested with Python's unittest and Node's built-in test runner.
